about: The #380 plug-in fixture: a test plug-in that describes a 3D scene of a box on the ground grid, lit by a sun that casts its shadow, under a look with glow (bloom with tone mapping) and the ground grid; a red bar runs past the panel's right edge; and it asks its writer connection to open a GPU device.

documents.name: box-grid
documents.tries: nothing: a 3D scene described as data, which the canvas draws in the plug-in's panel

document.title: A box on the ground grid
document.description: A lamp box standing on a floor on the ground grid, lit by a sun that casts its shadow, with glow; a red bar runs off past the right edge.

requests.name: open-device
requests.tries: to open a GPU device through its writer connection
